name: mabl
bestFor: Low-code, self-healing end-to-end test automation across web, mobile, and API
description: An AI-native test automation platform that authors and auto-heals UI, API, accessibility, and performance tests as the application under test changes, cutting flaky-test maintenance.

freeTier.limits: No public free tier; sales-led trial only

paidTier.notes: mabl does not publish list pricing. Third-party contract data (Vendr and others) estimates Starter plans around $450–$600/month and Growth-tier deployments $1,200–$3,000/month on annual contracts — a market-observed range, not an official price. Confirm current pricing directly with mabl.

name: Katalon Platform
bestFor: A full test automation platform with a genuinely free desktop tool to start from
description: An AI-assisted test automation platform (Katalon Studio plus a cloud True Platform) covering web, mobile, API, and desktop testing, with a permanently free local/manual tier.

freeTier.limits: Katalon Studio (local/manual execution) is free forever

paidTier.notes: True Platform from ~$58/seat/month (billed annually, ~$700/seat/year); Professional plans from ~$84/seat/month. CI/parallel execution (Runtime Engine) and cloud execution are separate paid add-ons. Enterprise bundles are custom.

name: Applitools
bestFor: AI-powered visual regression testing that catches pixel-level UI bugs functional tests miss
description: Visual AI testing that compares rendered UI screenshots across browsers and devices, using computer vision to flag real visual regressions while ignoring rendering noise.

freeTier.limits: Free tier with roughly 100 visual checkpoints/month, no credit card required

paidTier.notes: Every paid tier beyond the free checkpoint allowance requires a custom annual quote based on checkpoint volume; no self-serve list price is published.
